## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days |  |
| **G6PD normal (> 70% enzyme activity)** | TQ 300 mg |  |
| **G6PD deficient (< 30% enzyme activity)** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week over 8 weeks | Under medical supervision in areas with access to tertiary care and commenced on Day 4 after completion of blood stage treatment |
| **if no testing available** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days | Advise patients to monitor for clinical symptoms and referral to reference hospital if suspected G6PD deficient or adverse events |
